label: Bible Study
prompt: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: _____ shall not rise up the second time.
verse: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
note: Nahum's word to Judah about Assyria's threat — this trouble won't come around a second time.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy _____ shall be ended.
verse: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
note: A sun that never sets, because God Himself is the light — and the days of mourning are ended.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the _____, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verse: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
note: Jesus overturned the moneychangers' tables in the temple — and the dove-sellers lost their seats too.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose _____ ye were healed.
verse: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
note: Peter calls himself 'a witness of the sufferings of Christ' — here he hears Isaiah 53 in what he saw.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But there is _____ with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verse: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
note: Forgiveness doesn't make God casual; it makes him 'feared.' A song of ascents prayed 'out of the depths' (130:1).
